'''Atirha''' is a continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered by the [[Srandan Ocean]] to the north, [[Rianian Ocean]] to the east, and the [[Northern Eanif Ocean]] south and east, and [[Usscea Bay]] the south. The continent covers around {{convert|13,816,821|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 6nd largest continent in the world, with a total of about 538,280,000 as of 1765, making it also the 6th largest continent by population behind [[Massir]], [[Mahea]], [[Quia]], [[Acrola]] and [[Ayuma]].
